tasha: FYI onboarding Zenith-v0.0.5 (q4 int4 profile) to staging caused drops on a couple locale evals. zh->en BLEU baseline (fp16) 31.4 -> zenith-int4 27.5 on bench/xx_to_en_1k. ar->en down ~3.6 pts. Need quick triage.

tasha: Repro command I used:
```
python -m eval.translate --model zenith-v0.0.5 --quant int4 --dataset bench/xx_to_en_1k.jsonl --batch 16
```

tasha: Short examples: Chinese spacing and missing ZWJ artifacts
```
src: \u4ed6\u8bf4\uff1a\u201c\u6211\u4f1a\u8d70\u3002\u201d
fp16: He said, "I'll go."
int4: He said , " I ' ll go . "
```

kento: Could be detok/normalization policy in the int4 fast path. Any kernel tag on the canary?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for zenith-int4 used kernel tag `unicode/fast-normalize-v2` deployed 2026-03-22T03:18Z. Tokenizer package unchanged.

lydia: I tokenized the example locally, ids match for snippet:
```
fp16 ids: [300,1422,19,77,8009]
int4 ids: [300,1422,19,77,8009]
```
lydia: But detok logs from int4 show repeated lines: "norm: removed U+200D at pos 21" and "norm: stripped U+2067". That's RLI/ZWJ/LRI family.

marc: Dropping ZWJ/ZWNJ or RLI/LRI will break CJK joining and RTL isolation handling. Might also explain bracket reordering for Arabic.
marc: Quick hypothesis: fast-normalize-v2 enabled aggressive "ascii-first" heuristics that collapse zero-width controls to speed up token merging.

kento: Can you run an int4 eval with a preserve flag? e.g., --unicode-preserve or set env TEXT_NORMALIZE=compat-preserve. If BLEU recovers, we have root cause.

tasha: Running a 1k eval with TEXT_NORMALIZE=compat-preserve now, ETA ~10m.

lydia: I'll craft a minimal failing case (mixed RTL bracket + embedded Latin acronym + ZWJ) to attach to a kernel bug.

marc: If confirmed, rollout plan: pin int4 canary to `unicode/stable` and block `unicode/fast-normalize-v2` from prod until kernel fix. Also add eval fixture and a smoke check for removed control chars.


# quick update
tasha: Done. TEXT_NORMALIZE=compat-preserve int4 run: zh->en BLEU = 31.2 (near fp16). ar->en recovered as well. Looks like normalization policy is the culprit.

kento: Good confirmation. Can you paste a small detok log diff?

lydia: Attached diff in the kernel issue: shows int4 path calling `u8_strip_control(U+200D)` vs stable path logging `keep U+200D`. Opened issue #4231 with repro.

marc: I'll open rollback PR to pin the canary to `unicode/stable` and add a gating test in canary job that runs a small `eval/fixtures/zwc_bidi_cjk.jsonl`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback to `unicode/stable` started 2026-03-22T04:00Z for canary group canary-zenith.

kento: Action items: lydia minimal repro + issue, marc rollback PR + canary gating test, tasha run full regression suite post-rollback. Also add telemetry counter for dropped control codepoints per model/quant.

marc: I'll also propose a runtime opt-in flag in the API for aggressive ascii-normalize (customers who only need ascii flows) vs preserve-by-default for multilingual safety.

lydia: Adding test cases now. Will post PR/issue links here.

 tasha: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the triage log. :thumbsup:
